title: Customer list loads scoped to active company
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Company A has at least 3 active customers (mix of CASH_WALK_IN and CREDIT_ACCOUNT).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/customers.
2. Wait for the table to render.
3. Verify rows show code (CUST-####), display name, party type, customer kind, and status badge.
4. Confirm the company selector defaults to the active company.
5. Confirm no raw uid is visible in any table cell.
expected: Table lists only Company A customers. HTTP 200. ApiResponse envelope with data[] and meta. No uid visible in cells. Status badge text readable.

title: Customer list empty state
preconditions: A company with zero customers exists. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/customers.
2. Switch the company selector to the empty company.
3. Observe the rendered state.
expected: Distinct empty-state message rendered (not a spinner, not an error). No table rows. Paginator hidden. Create button still reachable for MANAGE-role users.

title: Customer list forbidden for user without CUSTOMER.VIEW
preconditions: A user with zero permissions is available.
steps:
1. Log in as the NO-PERMISSION user.
2. Confirm 'Customers' nav item is absent from the shell.
3. Navigate directly to /admin/customers.
4. Observe the screen state.
5. Call GET /api/v1/customers directly.
expected: Nav item hidden. Route guard blocks direct navigation – forbidden screen shown. Direct API call returns HTTP 403 with ApiResponse errors[].

title: Customer search by name (substring) and by TIN/phone/code (exact)
preconditions: Company A has customers with known name 'Acme Traders', TIN 123456789, phone 0712000111, code CUST-0007. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/customers.
2. Type 'Acme' in the search box; wait 300 ms debounce; assert only matching rows appear.
3. Clear; type exact TIN '123456789'; assert the matching customer appears.
4. Clear; type exact phone '0712000111'; assert match.
5. Clear; type exact code 'CUST-0007'; assert match.
6. Clear search; assert full list returns at page 0.
expected: Name search is case-insensitive substring. TIN/phone/code are exact-match only. Partial TIN returns no match. Blank query returns unfiltered list. Page resets to 0 on each new query.

title: Create INDIVIDUAL + CASH_WALK_IN customer (happy path)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Active company selected.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/customers; click 'New Customer'.
2. Enter display name 'Jane Walk-in', party type = Individual, kind = Cash/Walk-in.
3. Submit.
4. Verify new row appears with server-assigned code (CUST-#### prefix).
expected: HTTP 201. Success alert. New row appears with CUST-#### code. status=ACTIVE. No credit-limit or payment-terms fields sent. No uid visible in any label or cell.

title: Create BUSINESS + CREDIT_ACCOUNT customer with credit limit and payment terms
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Active company selected.
steps:
1. Open create form: displayName='Mega Distributors', party type=Business, TIN=100200300, vatRegistered=yes, VRN='40-123456-X', kind=Credit Account. Submit.
2. Open the created customer at /admin/customers/uid/:uid.
3. Set creditLimit amount=5000000, currency=TZS, paymentTermsDays=30. Save.
expected: Create returns 201. Edit returns 200. Credit limit stored as MoneyDto. Detail shows 'TZS 5,000,000.00'. paymentTermsDays=30 persisted.

title: Reject BUSINESS customer without TIN (BR-PARTY-04)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open create form; party type=Business; leave TIN blank; displayName='No-TIN Ltd'.
2. Submit.
3. If UI is bypassed, call POST /api/v1/customers with partyType=BUSINESS, tin=null.
expected: UI blocks with 'A business party must have a TIN'. API returns HTTP 400 with BR-PARTY-04 message in errors[]. Whitespace-only TIN also rejected.

title: Reject VRN when vatRegistered=false (BR-PARTY-06)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. POST /api/v1/customers with vatRegistered=false, vrn='40-9999'.
2. In the UI, verify unchecking VAT clears the VRN field and prevents submission with a VRN.
expected: HTTP 400. Message 'VRN may only be set when the customer is VAT-registered (BR-PARTY-06)'. UI prevents this combination by clearing VRN when VAT is unchecked.

title: Credit fields hidden for CASH_WALK_IN, shown for CREDIT_ACCOUNT
preconditions: An existing CASH_WALK_IN customer. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open /admin/customers/uid/:uid for a CASH_WALK_IN customer.
2. Confirm Credit Limit and Payment Terms fields are NOT shown.
3. Change kind to Credit Account; confirm fields appear.
4. Change back to Cash/Walk-in; confirm fields hide.
expected: Fields are conditionally shown based on customerKind. Switching to cash clears credit data on save. No half-credit-pair sent.

title: VIEW-only role: no create/edit/archive affordances
preconditions: A custom role user with CUSTOMER.VIEW only (no CUSTOMER.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Log in as view-only user.
2. Navigate to /admin/customers: list renders but 'New Customer' button is hidden.
3. Open a detail: Save and Archive controls are hidden.
4. Attempt POST /api/v1/customers directly.
5. Attempt PUT /api/v1/customers/uid/{uid}/archive directly.
expected: List and detail readable. All mutation buttons hidden (canManage=false). Direct POST and archive PUT return HTTP 403.

title: Archive then restore a customer (ACTIVE → ARCHIVED → ACTIVE)
preconditions: An ACTIVE customer. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open an ACTIVE customer; click Archive.
2. Verify status badge shows ARCHIVED. HTTP 204.
3. Click Restore.
4. Verify status badge shows ACTIVE. HTTP 204.
expected: HTTP 204 each. Soft-delete (status flip, record retained). Audit events CUSTOMER_ARCHIVE and CUSTOMER_RESTORE recorded. Re-archiving an already-ARCHIVED customer is idempotent.

title: Assign customer to branch (same company); duplicate rejected; cross-company denied
preconditions: Customer in Company A. Company A has at least 2 branches. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open customer detail; Branch Associations panel.
2. Select company by name, then select branch by 'code — name'; click Assign. HTTP 201.
3. Assign the same branch again. Expect 409.
4. Via API, POST with a Company-B branch uid. Expect 403.
testData: Branch 'BR-02 — Mwanza'. Company-B branch uid for negative test.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 201; association row shows 'code — name'. Step 3: HTTP 409 'already associated'. Step 4: HTTP 403 (BR-PARTY-01). Branch uid is never typed by the user — selected from dropdown.

title: Cross-tenant customer list isolation (company A cannot see company B rows)
preconditions: Two companies A and B. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN of Company A.
steps:
1. GET /api/v1/customers?companyId=<B-id> as Company A admin.
2. Attempt GET /api/v1/customers/uid/<B-customer-uid> as Company A admin.
testData: Company B's companyId and a known customer uid belonging to Company B.
expected: Both requests return HTTP 403 (ScopeGuard.assertCanActIn blocks before querying). Company B rows never appear in Company A's list.

title: Create GOODS supplier (BUSINESS) — happy path
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Active company selected.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/suppliers; click 'New Supplier'.
2. Party type=Business, TIN=200300400, kind=Goods, displayName='Bulk Supplies Ltd'. Submit.
testData: displayName='Bulk Supplies Ltd', partyType=BUSINESS, supplierKind=GOODS, tin=200300400.
expected: HTTP 201. Status ACTIVE. Code SUPP-#### assigned. Row appears. Business-without-TIN attempt returns HTTP 400 with BR-PARTY-04 message.

title: Create SERVICE supplier (INDIVIDUAL) — happy path
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Active company selected.
steps: 1. Open create; party type=Individual, kind=Service, displayName='John Consulting'. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. supplierKind=SERVICE persisted and displayed. Code SUPP-#### assigned. status=ACTIVE.

title: Archive / restore supplier; VIEW-only denied writes
preconditions: An ACTIVE supplier. ORG_ADMIN and a view-only custom role user available.
steps:
1. As ORG_ADMIN: archive the supplier (HTTP 204); restore it (HTTP 204).
2. As view-only user: confirm archive/restore buttons are hidden.
3. Attempt PUT /api/v1/suppliers/uid/{uid}/archive as view-only user.
expected: Archive and restore succeed for ORG_ADMIN (204 each). View-only user sees no buttons; direct API returns 403.

title: Create EXTERNAL agent (no user link)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Active company selected.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/agents; click 'New Agent'.
2. Kind=External, displayName='Field Rep Co', partyType=Individual. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. appUserId=null (service forces null for EXTERNAL). Code AGNT-#### assigned. User selector not shown for EXTERNAL. status=ACTIVE.

title: Create INTERNAL agent linked to an ACTIVE company user
preconditions: An ACTIVE non-root user (SALES_REP) in Company A. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open agent detail or create form; set kind=Internal.
2. A user selector appears. Choose the SALES_REP user by name.
3. Save.
testData: agentKind=INTERNAL, appUserId=<SALES_REP id resolved from picker>.
expected: HTTP 200/201. appUserId persisted. Agent shows linked user name. User selected by NAME via selector, id stored under the hood.

title: Reject INTERNAL agent with no user, inactive user, root user, or wrong-company user
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. POST agent kind=INTERNAL without appUserId → expect 400 (BR-PARTY-10).
2. POST with appUserId of an INACTIVE user → expect 400.
3. POST with appUserId of rootadmin → expect 400.
4. POST with appUserId of a Company-B user → expect 400.
expected: All four attempts return HTTP 400 with 'internal agent must reference an ACTIVE non-root user belonging to the agent's company (BR-PARTY-10)'. DB chk_agent_user_kind is the backstop.

title: Switch INTERNAL agent to EXTERNAL clears user link
preconditions: An INTERNAL agent linked to a user. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps: 1. Open agent detail; change kind to External (user selector disappears). Save.
testData: Existing INTERNAL agent with a user link.
expected: HTTP 200. appUserId set to null for EXTERNAL. Agent no longer shows a user link. Switching EXTERNAL back to INTERNAL without selecting a user returns 400 (BR-PARTY-10).

title: Create other party with free-text otherKind
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Active company selected.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/other-parties; click 'New Other Party'.
2. PartyType=Business, TIN=300400500, otherKind='Landlord', displayName='City Properties'. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. otherKind stored verbatim (no enum validation). Code OTHR-#### assigned. status=ACTIVE. otherKind blank is also allowed (nullable).

title: Create GOODS product with auto-assigned code
preconditions: Active company with at least 1 ACTIVE UoM (e.g. EA — Each). Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/products; click 'New product'.
2. Leave Code blank; Name='Sugar 1kg'; Type=GOODS; Stockable=checked; Sellable=checked.
3. Select Base Unit 'EA — Each' from the unit dropdown by name.
4. Cost=1000 TZS; VAT Status=STANDARD. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. New row with system code PROD-####. stockable=true. type=GOODS. status=ACTIVE. Base unit chosen by name — uid not typed.

title: Create SERVICE product forces stockable=false (BR-PROD-01)
preconditions: Active company with at least 1 ACTIVE UoM. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open product create form.
2. Set Type=SERVICE.
3. Observe Stockable checkbox becomes disabled and unchecked.
4. Fill name='Delivery Service', base unit='EA'. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. type=SERVICE, stockable=false. UI never permits stockable SERVICE. Attempting POST with type=SERVICE, stockable=true directly returns a DB CHECK error.

title: Duplicate product code per company rejected
preconditions: Product with code 'SKU-001' already exists in Company A. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps: 1. Create a second product with code='SKU-001' in the same company. Submit.
expected: HTTP 409/constraint error. Duplicate code rejected (uq_product_company_code). Same code in a different company is allowed.

title: Archive and restore a product (ACTIVE → ARCHIVED → ACTIVE)
preconditions: An ACTIVE product. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open product detail; click Archive. Verify status=ARCHIVED (HTTP 204).
2. Click Restore. Verify status=ACTIVE (HTTP 204).
3. Confirm archived products are excluded from component/base-unit pickers.
expected: HTTP 204 each. Soft-delete preserved. ARCHIVED products not selectable in recipe-component or BOM pickers (BR-PROD-05).

title: Add bulk pack with conversion factor; reject factor <= 0
preconditions: Product with base unit EA. An ACTIVE UoM 'CTN' in the same company. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open product detail; Bulk Packs panel.
2. Select unit 'CTN — Carton' by name; enter factor=24; Add.
3. Attempt Add with factor=0; expect validation error.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 201; row shows unit+factor. Step 3: 'factorToBase must be greater than zero (BR-PROD-03)' — no call made. API rejects factor<=0 via @DecimalMin 0.000001.

title: Line unit must be product's base or a configured bulk-pack unit (UoM restriction)
preconditions: Product 'Widget' has base unit EA and one bulk pack CTN (factor 24). Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Attempt to add a sales order line for 'Widget' with a unit that is neither EA nor CTN (e.g. KG).
2. Observe backend/UI rejection.
testData: Product with base EA and bulk pack CTN. Attempted line unit=KG.
expected: Line unit not in the product's configured units is rejected. Only EA (base) and CTN (configured pack) are selectable/valid for this product's lines.

title: Set product price on a price list; remove price
preconditions: Product exists. An ACTIVE price list 'RETAIL' in the same company. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open product detail; Prices panel.
2. Select price list 'RETAIL — Retail' by name; enter amount=1500, currency=TZS; Set price (HTTP 201).
3. Click Remove on the price row (HTTP 204).
expected: Step 2: HTTP 201; price row shows list name + formatted money. Step 3: HTTP 204; row removed. Price list chosen by code/name — uid stored under the hood.

title: POS barcode lookup resolves to product (company-scoped); cross-tenant barcode not found
preconditions: Product in Company A has barcode '6001234567890'. Company B has different products. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN of Company A.
steps:
1. On /admin/products, type barcode '6001234567890' in the scan box; trigger lookup.
2. Try a Company-B barcode value.
testData: Barcode '6001234567890' (Company A). A Company-B barcode value.
expected: Step 1: resolves to Company A product (name/code shown). Step 2: 404 not found — no cross-tenant leak.

title: Product create blocked for VIEW-only role
preconditions: Custom role with PRODUCT.VIEW only. Logged in as that user.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/products; confirm 'New product' button is hidden.
2. Attempt POST /api/v1/products directly.
expected: Create button hidden (canManage=false). Direct POST returns HTTP 403.

title: Create UoM; duplicate code per company rejected; archived UoM excluded from pickers
preconditions: Active company. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/units; click 'New unit'; code='CTN', name='Carton'. Submit (HTTP 201).
2. Create another unit with code='CTN' in the same company — expect rejection.
3. Archive the CTN unit; verify it no longer appears in product base-unit or bulk-pack dropdowns.
expected: Step 1: HTTP 201; unit ACTIVE. Step 2: duplicate code rejected. Step 3: ARCHIVED unit absent from product unit pickers.

title: Create, edit, archive, and restore a price list
preconditions: Active company. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/price-lists; click 'New price list'; code='RETAIL', name='Retail'. Submit (201).
2. Edit name inline; save (200).
3. Archive (204) → badge ARCHIVED.
4. Restore (204) → badge ACTIVE.
expected: Full CRUD and lifecycle. PriceListDto envelopes. Duplicate code per company rejected. View-only role: writes hidden/403.

title: View the three seeded VAT bands; edit STANDARD rate
preconditions: Company with seeded tax rates (STANDARD, ZERO_RATED, EXEMPT). Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/tax-rates; confirm 3 rows with label, rate, status.
2. Click Edit on STANDARD; set rate=0.18; Save.
3. Attempt rate=1.0 — expect validation failure.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 200; rate updated. Step 3: HTTP 400 (@DecimalMax 0.9999 + chk_tax_rate_value). No create or archive endpoint for tax rates.

title: Add FX rate (effective-dated, append-only); reject same-currency pair and rate <= 0
preconditions: Company A. USD and TZS active currencies. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/fx/rates; click 'New rate'.
2. From=USD, To=TZS, rate=2600, effectiveDate=today, rateType=SPOT, source=MANUAL. Submit (201).
3. Attempt From=TZS, To=TZS — expect client error.
4. Attempt rate=-1 — expect validation error.
testData: USD→TZS @ 2600. Negative tests: same currency pair, negative rate.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 201; rate row appears. Step 3: client blocks 'currencies must differ'. Step 4: 'Rate must be positive'. FX rates are append-only — a correction is a new row, not an edit.

title: Create route; assign customer (ROUTE.ASSIGN); assign branch (ROUTE.MANAGE); INTERNAL agent rejected
preconditions: Active company with customers, an EXTERNAL agent, and at least 2 branches. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/routes; create route 'North Zone', locationId='NZ-01' (HTTP 201).
2. Open route detail; Customers panel: pick customer by 'code — name'; Assign (HTTP 201).
3. Agents panel: pick EXTERNAL agent by name; check Primary; Assign (HTTP 201).
4. Attempt to assign an INTERNAL agent — expect rejection.
5. Branches panel: pick branch by 'code — name'; Assign (HTTP 201) — note this requires ROUTE.MANAGE, not ROUTE.ASSIGN.
testData: Route 'North Zone'. Customer 'CUST-001 — Acme Stores'. EXTERNAL agent 'AG-002 — Field Rep'. Branch 'BR-02 — Mwanza'.
expected: Route created (code auto-assigned). Customer and EXTERNAL agent assigned (HTTP 201 each). INTERNAL agent rejected ('Only EXTERNAL agents may be assigned to a route'). Branch assigned with ROUTE.MANAGE; a ROUTE.ASSIGN-only user gets 403 on branch assign.

title: Create a draft quotation (CREDIT_ACCOUNT customer)
preconditions: Company with default branch. Active BUSINESS/CREDIT_ACCOUNT customer. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN with active branch header.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/quotations; click 'New quotation'.
2. Pick customer by name from the dropdown.
3. Set quoteDate=today, validUntil=today+30.
4. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. DRAFT quotation row appears with status badge DRAFT. No QUOTE-#### number yet (allocated on send). Customer chosen by name — no uid typed or shown. ApiResponse<QuotationDto>.

title: Add GOODS line to draft quotation with line discount %; reject invalid combinations
preconditions: DRAFT quotation (O2C-001). A sellable GOODS product with company price and VAT rate. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open quotation detail; product search → select product by code/name.
2. Choose unit, qty=10, discountPercent=5. Add line.
3. Verify line shows computed net/VAT/gross. Quotation totals recompute.
4. Attempt to set both discountPercent and discountAmount on the same line — expect rejection.
expected: HTTP 201 for line. Totals computed server-side (not client). Setting both discount types returns 400 (DiscountValidator). Qty<=0 returns validation error. Product with no price returns 400.

title: Add SERVICE line to draft quotation
preconditions: DRAFT quotation. Sellable SERVICE product with company price and VAT rate.
steps: 1. Add a SERVICE product line (qty=2) to the quotation.
expected: HTTP 201. Line added and priced identically to a goods line. No reservation concept applies to service lines.

title: Send quotation (DRAFT → SENT, allocates QUOTE-#### number)
preconditions: DRAFT quotation with at least 1 line. validUntil >= today.
steps:
1. On quotation detail, click 'Send'.
2. Observe status badge changes to SENT and a QUOTE-#### number appears in the header.
testData: DRAFT quotation with 1+ lines and future validUntil.
expected: HTTP 204. status=SENT. quoteNumber allocated (QUOTE-####). sentAt stamped. Attempting to send with zero lines is blocked by UI (canSendNow = isDraft && lines>0). Sending with validUntil in the past returns 400.

title: Accept quotation (SENT → ACCEPTED) creates Sales Order
preconditions: SENT quotation with validUntil >= today.
steps:
1. On quotation detail, click 'Accept'.
2. Observe success toast with new SO number.
3. Navigate to the new Sales Order.
expected: HTTP 201. quotation status=ACCEPTED with convertedOrderUid. New DRAFT Sales Order created with sourceQuotationUid set and lines copied. Accepting a DRAFT quotation returns 400. Accepting an expired SENT quotation auto-flips it to EXPIRED and returns 400.

title: Reject quotation (SENT → REJECTED)
preconditions: SENT quotation.
steps:
1. On quotation detail, click 'Reject'.
2. Verify status=REJECTED and rejectedAt stamped.
expected: HTTP 204. status=REJECTED. Toast 'Quotation rejected'. Rejecting a DRAFT quotation returns 400. Reject shares the SALES.QUOTE.ACCEPT permission.

title: Illegal quotation transition matrix
preconditions: Quotations in each status: DRAFT, SENT, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, EXPIRED. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Attempt to send a SENT/ACCEPTED/REJECTED/EXPIRED quote.
2. Attempt to accept a DRAFT/ACCEPTED/REJECTED/EXPIRED quote.
3. Attempt to reject a DRAFT/ACCEPTED/REJECTED/EXPIRED quote.
4. Attempt to add/remove a line on a SENT/ACCEPTED quote.
expected: Every illegal transition returns HTTP 400 with descriptive errors[]. No state change persisted.

title: Create standalone draft Sales Order (CASH_WALK_IN customer) with document discount
preconditions: Company with default branch. An INDIVIDUAL/CASH_WALK_IN customer. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/sales-orders; open create form.
2. Pick customer by name; set orderDate=today; docDiscountPercent=2. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. DRAFT SO with order number. No stock reserved yet. Setting both docDiscountPercent AND docDiscountAmount returns 400. Creating in an unassigned branch returns 403.

title: Add GOODS and SERVICE lines to draft Sales Order
preconditions: DRAFT Sales Order (O2C-008). Sellable GOODS and SERVICE products with company price and VAT rate.
steps:
1. Add a GOODS line: qty=20, lineDiscountAmount=1000.
2. Add a SERVICE line: qty=1.
3. Verify line totals and SO totals recompute server-side.
testData: GOODS product qty=20 discount=1000. SERVICE product qty=1.
expected: HTTP 201 each. Lines show orderedQty, listPrice, net/VAT/gross from DTO. qtyReservedBase/qtyFulfilledBase/qtyInvoicedBase start at 0. Adding a line to a CONFIRMED SO returns 400.

title: Confirm Sales Order reserves stock (DRAFT → CONFIRMED)
preconditions: DRAFT SO with at least 1 GOODS line. Product has on-hand stock in the branch. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. On SO detail, click 'Confirm'.
2. Observe toast 'Order confirmed — stock reserved'.
3. Verify each line shows reservedQty = orderedQty. Status badge=CONFIRMED.
4. Verify reserved stock for the product/branch increased by the ordered base qty.
testData: DRAFT SO with a GOODS line (qty=10).
expected: HTTP 204. status=CONFIRMED. confirmedAt stamped. qtyReservedBase=qtyOrderedBase per line. Confirming an SO with zero lines returns 400. Confirming an already-CONFIRMED SO returns 400.

title: Cancel confirmed Sales Order releases reservation (→ CANCELLED)
preconditions: CONFIRMED SO with reserved stock (O2C-010). Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. On SO detail, open Cancel form; enter reason='Customer changed mind'. Submit.
2. Verify status=CANCELLED and per-line reserved qty returns to 0.
3. Verify stock reservation released.
expected: HTTP 204. status=CANCELLED. cancelledAt and cancelReason stamped. Reservation negated. Cancelling a CLOSED SO returns 400. Reason is optional (null allowed).

title: SO status rollup: partial delivery → PARTIALLY_FULFILLED → FULFILLED
preconditions: CONFIRMED SO with single GOODS line qty=10.
steps:
1. Create delivery for qty=6 against the line.
2. Verify SO status=PARTIALLY_FULFILLED; line fulfilled=6, open=4.
3. Create second delivery for remaining qty=4.
4. Verify SO status=FULFILLED; line fulfilled=10, open=0.
testData: SO line qty=10. Delivery 1: qty=6. Delivery 2: qty=4.
expected: After partial delivery: PARTIALLY_FULFILLED. After full delivery: FULFILLED. Attempting to deliver qty=11 against open=10 returns 400 (BR-SO-11).

title: SO status rollup: invoicing → PARTIALLY_INVOICED → CLOSED
preconditions: FULLY-FULFILLED SO across two deliveries (O2C-012).
steps:
1. Generate invoice from delivery #1 (qty=6) and finalise.
2. Verify SO=PARTIALLY_INVOICED.
3. Generate invoice from delivery #2 (qty=4) and finalise.
4. Verify SO=CLOSED.
testData: Two deliveries fully covering the SO.
expected: PARTIALLY_INVOICED after first invoice. CLOSED after second (fully-fulfilled + fully-invoiced triggers CLOSED via deriveStatus). INVOICED enum value is not used in the v1 rollup.

title: Create a full delivery against confirmed SO (CONFIRMED status, GOODS stock issued)
preconditions: CONFIRMED SO with open GOODS line qty=10. Product has stock. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/deliveries/create for the SO (selected by SO number).
2. Form loads open lines; default each qty input to the open balance.
3. Set deliveryDate=today; keep full qty=10. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. Delivery created directly in CONFIRMED status with DELIVERY-#### number. SO line qtyFulfilledBase+=10. Reservation released. SO status → FULFILLED. DELIVERY.CONFIRMED domain event published (stock issued + COGS).

title: Create partial delivery (backorder); over-qty rejected
preconditions: CONFIRMED SO with GOODS line qty=10.
steps:
1. On delivery-create form, set line qty=6 (less than open=10). Submit.
2. Verify SO status=PARTIALLY_FULFILLED; line fulfilled=6, open=4.
3. Attempt delivery with qty=11 (exceeds open=10).
testData: Partial delivery qty=6. Over-qty test qty=11.
expected: Step 1: HTTP 201; SO PARTIALLY_FULFILLED. Step 3: UI blocks 'Quantity exceeds open balance (10)' AND backend returns 400 'Delivery qty 11 exceeds open qty 10 (BR-SO-11)'.

title: Deliver against DRAFT or CANCELLED SO is rejected
preconditions: A DRAFT SO and a CANCELLED SO. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Attempt POST /api/v1/deliveries referencing a DRAFT SO.
2. Attempt POST /api/v1/deliveries referencing a CANCELLED SO.
testData: DRAFT SO uid and CANCELLED SO uid.
expected: Both return HTTP 400 'Can only deliver against a CONFIRMED or PARTIALLY_FULFILLED order'.

title: Generate DRAFT invoice from delivery (origin=SALES_ORDER)

steps:

title: Checkout validation: required fields and line validation block submit
preconditions: OPEN session present. User with POS.SALE.CREATE.
steps:
1. Submit with no session → 'Session is required.'.
2. Add session; submit with no customer → 'Customer is required.'.
3. Clear currency → 'Currency is required.'.
4. No line items → 'Add at least one line item.'.
5. Line with no product → 'Select a product for every line.'.
6. Line with no unit → 'Select a unit for every line.'.
7. Qty=0 → 'Quantity must be positive for every line.'.
8. Unit price negative → 'Unit price must be non-negative for every line.'.
expected: Each missing/invalid field blocks submit with the exact inline error message. No POST fired until all fields valid.

title: Tendered amount must cover total; negative change blocked
preconditions: Sale total=3000. User with POS.SALE.CREATE.
steps:
1. Build a sale totalling 3000; enter tendered=2000.
2. Observe change shows 'TZS -1,000.00' in danger colour.
3. Attempt to submit.
expected: Submit blocked client-side: 'Tendered amount is less than the total.' Tendered blank/negative → 'Tendered amount must be a valid non-negative number.' Tendered equal to total (change=0) is allowed.

title: Sale on CLOSED session rejected (UI filters + API guard)
preconditions: A CLOSED session. User with POS.SALE.CREATE.
steps:

2. Directly POST /api/v1/pos/sales with a CLOSED sessionUid.
expected: UI: CLOSED session absent from picker. API: HTTP 409 'POS session is not OPEN'. Non-existent sessionUid returns 404.

title: POS sale tender is CASH-only; MOBILE_MONEY not selectable (Defect TENDER)
preconditions: OPEN session. User with POS.SALE.CREATE.
steps:
1. Inspect the checkout UI — confirm no tender-type selector exists (only 'Tendered Amount').
2. Inspect PosSaleRequest — confirm no tender field.
3. Process a sale and inspect the created invoice's payment tender type.
expected: Exactly one payment of TenderType.CASH for the full gross is recorded (processSale hardcodes CASH). MOBILE_MONEY is unreachable via POS. Documented as DEFECT-POS-TENDER — not a test failure, a known gap.

title: POS sale with no agent rejected by backend despite UI marking agent optional (Defect AGENT)
preconditions: OPEN session. Valid customer and GOODS line.
steps:
1. Build a valid sale but leave Agent empty (UI labels it 'optional').
2. Submit 'Complete Sale'.
testData: Valid POS sale configuration with agent field empty.
expected: UI passes client validation; POST fires with agentId=undefined. Backend rejects with HTTP 400 because PosSaleRequest.agentId is @NotNull. Error surfaces as 'Could not process sale.' Documented as DEFECT-POS-AGENT — mismatch between UI (optional) and backend (required).

title: Multi-line sale with discount; remove a line; totals recompute
preconditions: OPEN session. Two sellable products. User with POS.SALE.CREATE.

4. Remove line B → Total recomputes to 2800.
testData: Product A qty=3 × 1000 discount=200. Product B qty=1 × 500.
expected: Client subtotal = Σ(qty×price - discount). Total updates on line removal. Server-side invoice math governs the authoritative gross. Table has accessible caption and scoped headers (axe clean).

title: Cashier vs Manager capability split: Close and Reconcile restricted to Manager
preconditions: Two custom roles: Cashier (POS.SESSION.OPEN + POS.SALE.CREATE + POS.SESSION.VIEW); Manager (all POS.* codes including CLOSE and RECONCILE).
steps:
1. As Cashier: open session, ring a sale, view X-read. Confirm 'Close Session' and 'Reconcile' buttons are HIDDEN. Confirm /admin/pos/tills redirects (no POS.TILL.VIEW).
2. As Manager: create/deactivate tills, close and reconcile sessions.
3. As Cashier, force POST .../close.
testData: Cashier and Manager custom role configurations.
expected: Cashier cannot close or reconcile sessions (buttons hidden; forced API call returns 403). Manager can perform all operations. UI controls and API both enforce the permission boundary independently.

title: Full POS day: open → sell → payout → X-read → close (over) → reconcile → Z-read + GL journal
preconditions: Active till. GOODS product (price=1500). Walk-in customer. ACTIVE agent. GL configs CASH/POS_CASH_OVER seeded. User: rootadmin or custom role with all POS.* codes.
steps:
1. /admin/pos/sessions → Open Session on the till, float=50000.
2. /admin/pos/sell → ring sale: 2 × 1500=3000, tendered=3000, change=0; Complete Sale.
3. Session detail → Record Payout PAID_OUT amount=1000, reason='petty cash'. Expected cash now 50000+3000-1000=52000.
4. X-read: assert Sales Total=3000, Payouts=1000, Expected Cash=52000, Invoice Count=1.
5. Close Session with Counted Cash=52100 → Variance=+100.00 (OVER).
6. Reconcile → Z-Read: Variance=+100.00, Journal ID shown; Status=RECONCILED.
7. Verify GL journal: DR CASH 100 / CR 4900 100, source=POS_VARIANCE.
testData: Opening float=50000. Sale 2 × 1500. Payout=1000. Counted cash=52100.
expected: Each step advances state correctly. Expected cash formula verified. Variance journal posted and balanced. Final status=RECONCILED. Attempting close or reconcile again returns 409.
